temporal_policy: Require a valid single calendar date per participant and concept. Mean repeated numeric records within each exact source on that date, then equally average eligible BP1/BP2 source means. Do not average across eyes. Multiple dates, conflicting questionnaire answers, mismatched source concept IDs or units invalidate that participant-concept label. Targets are recorded clinical measurements and questionnaire responses whose dates can differ across sources. A single date within each concept does not guarantee eligibility at a prediction time or establish that a label precedes the outcome.
forbidden_source_policy: Only these exact 12 active concept definitions and listed source/OMOP IDs are allowed. Deferred biomarkers, MoCA items/total, CVD outcome components, administrative and acquisition indicators never enter the initial bottleneck.
limitations: Frozen-representation concept supervision is independent of model inputs.
Recorded numeric values are used without blind unit conversion or recalculation.
Final task- and split-specific validity still depends on measurement timing and source-data review.
NT-proBNP and Troponin T remain documented deferred candidates; their censored values are not imputed or recoded into new indicators.
